children: Overview
China chipmaker's half-year revenue rose
Net profit attributable to shareholders surged
Results driven by industry recovery, higher demand, and improved product mix
Outlook
Shanghai Fudan sets 2026 FPGA and high-reliability memory revenue growth target of at least 15% versus 2024
Result Drivers
IC DEMAND RECOVERY – Industry recovery and stronger downstream demand lifted revenue and gross profit across all IC design product lines
STRATEGIC SHARE GAIN – Fair-value gains on strategic allotment shares boosted net profit by about RMB420 mln
MEMORY PRICE-VOLUME GAINS – Robust non-volatile-memory demand, with higher volumes and prices, supported revenue growth
